content_zh:
【欢迎来到，仙灵世界！】
“尊敬的冒险勇者【爱吃包子】，你已随机降临在仙灵世界寒月大陆号一级据点，马上开启你的修炼旅程吧，祝你早日成仙！”
随着眼前的字幕渐渐淡化消失，映入方南山眼中的是一片昏暗萧瑟景象。
“这不跟网游是一样的吗？我看看，这就是仙界？怎么看起来像魔界地狱？这乌黑的枯枝败草，这些散落的骷髅头和碎骨，还有这玩意……我的天老爷！真的是会动的骷髅！这么高这么大？还好据点有保护罩，这玩意真的是据点边最低级的怪物吗？”
方南山好奇的打量四周的环境。
仙灵世界对蓝星开放已经十年，早有完整的攻略流程，学校里甚至开设有专门的课程教导学生们进入仙灵世界之后如何起步发展。
蓝星里各个国家，每个年满十六岁的公民，经过身体检测合格之后，都将获得进入仙灵世界的通行资格证。
仙灵世界是一个真实的世界，但其他宇宙世界的生灵降临此界，并不是本体直接进入，只是一丝灵魂连接进入，承载这一丝灵魂的躯体，是仙灵世界的一个特殊系统塑造的肉身。
灵魂在连接至此界后，会进入一个特殊空间，在空间里以自己的意愿塑造一个真实的身体，然后以此肉身承载灵魂降临在这方世界的真实大地上。
在这个世界里获得的物品，可以花费一定的代价，提取回自己本体的世界使用。
“没想到我重回十六岁，还以为回到原来的世界，却居然是这么有趣的一个平行世界，看来我先天不足的缺陷真的可以在这里获得修复，再也不用担心活不过三十岁了！妈，我一定会如你所愿，寿比南山的。”
三天前他不相信这一切是真实的，直到现在，真真切切的踏在仙灵世界的土地上，他才激动的握紧双拳，喜悦之情洋溢脸上，眼中甚至有点点泪光。
前世他只活到二十七岁，就无奈的离世，没想到一睁眼，竟然回到十六岁刚开学不久的高中课堂上，随后发现这个世界，已经不是原来的世界了。
这个世界在大约十年前，忽然与一个修仙世界连接，整个世界也随之发生了翻天覆地的变化。
“f*ck!怎么跟外星种族降临同一个据点！这次完蛋了！第一次降临的机会浪费了！”
耳中忽然传来一阵暴躁的叫骂声，方南山思绪顿时被拉了回来，心中一惊，马上转身观察据点情形。
脑中闪过一些信息，教科书上明确描述了每个初进仙灵世界的人将会遇到的情景，以及要如何应对才能快速度过最初的艰难阶段。
每个人都是随机降临的，而降临的个体，不但有蓝星各国各族的成员，还有其他世界或宇宙的智慧生灵，有些甚至不是人形种族的生物体。
初始的一级据点，只是一个半径为十米的半圆保护罩，护罩内部可以看作是安全区，可以免受魔气的侵蚀以及怪物的袭击，降生者之间也不能互相攻击。
一级据点只能容纳十个人，每次降临的十人，都是各个世界进入的成员群中随机匹配的，如果运气好，说不定能匹配到本国的同胞，但多数情况下，都是跟其他陌生世界的成员一起降临，能有一个熟悉面孔就算是撞大运了。

方南山这次运气就不怎么好，除了一个西方白人面孔的少年，其他八人都是明显的异星种族，不是头额有角就是四肢有爪或有蹄之类的奇形怪状。
“真倒霉，居然有两个邪恶的蓝星人族，各位，要不要先把他们干掉？”异星种族成员，显然意见更大，一见到方南山和那名白人，马上避若蛇蝎的聚到一起，警惕的看着他俩。
看来蓝星人族名声在外啊。
“我蓝星华族的。”方南山淡然开口。
“哦，原来是蓝星唯一讲诚信的华族人，那还好。”长了一双牛蹄的独角兽人形态的异星种族，松了一口气，认真的打量一番方南山，低声与其他异人商讨。
“叛徒！华族居然不跟蓝星联盟的成员一起结伴，共同对外，反而向外星异族低头求饶，真是人族之耻！我一定会把你们华族的无耻行径公布出去……”小白皮瞪大眼睛，愤怒的看向方南山，大声指责着。
方南山摆摆手，打断他的慷慨陈词，“滚一边去。”
content_en:
【Welcome to the fairy world! 】
"Dear adventurous brave [loves buns], you have randomly arrived at the first-level stronghold of Hanyue Continent in the fairy world. Start your cultivation journey immediately. I wish you will become an immortal as soon as possible!"
As the subtitles in front of him gradually faded and disappeared, Fang Nanshan's eyes were greeted by a dark and desolate scene.
"Isn't this the same as an online game? Let's see, this is the fairy world? Why does it look like the devil's hell? These black dead branches and dead grass, these scattered skulls and broken bones, and this thing... Oh my god! It's really a moving skeleton! So tall and big? Fortunately, the stronghold has a protective cover. Is this really the lowest level monster around the stronghold?"
Fang Nanshan looked at his surroundings curiously.
The Fairy World has been open to Blue Star for ten years, and it already has a complete guide process. The school even offers special courses to teach students how to start and develop after entering the Fairy World.
In every country in the Blue Star, every citizen over the age of 16 will receive a pass to enter the fairy world after passing the physical examination.
The fairy world is a real world, but when the creatures from other universes come to this world, they do not enter directly with their bodies, but only with a trace of their souls. The body that carries this trace of soul is a body shaped by a special system of the fairy world.
After the soul is connected to this world, it will enter a special space, where it can shape a real body according to its own wishes, and then use this body to carry the soul and descend to the real land of this world.
The items obtained in this world can be extracted back to the original world for use at a certain price.
"I didn't expect that I would be sixteen again. I thought I would return to my original world, but it turned out to be such an interesting parallel world. It seems that my congenital defects can really be repaired here, and I no longer have to worry about not living past thirty! Mom, I will definitely live longer than you wish, as you wish."
Three days ago, he didn't believe that all of this was real. It was only now, when he really stepped on the land of the fairy world, that he clenched his fists in excitement, joy overflowing on his face, and even a little tears in his eyes.
In his previous life, he only lived to be twenty-seven, and then passed away helplessly. Unexpectedly, when he opened his eyes, he would be back in the high school classroom when he was sixteen years old, not long after school started. Then he discovered that this world was no longer the original world.
About ten years ago, this world suddenly connected with a world of cultivating immortals, and the whole world also underwent earth-shaking changes.
"F*ck! Why did the alien race descend on the same base! This time it's over! The first opportunity to descend was wasted!"
Suddenly, there was a burst of violent yelling in his ears. Fang Nanshan was suddenly pulled back from his thoughts. He was startled and immediately turned around to observe the situation at the stronghold.
Some information flashed through my mind. The textbook clearly described the situations that everyone who first entered the fairy world would encounter, and how to deal with it in order to quickly get through the initial difficult stage.
Everyone comes randomly, and the individuals who come include not only members of various races on Blue Star, but also intelligent beings from other worlds or universes, and some are not even organisms from humanoid races.
The initial first-level stronghold is just a semicircular protective shield with a radius of ten meters. The inside of the shield can be regarded as a safe zone, which can be protected from the erosion of demonic energy and the attacks of monsters, and the born cannot attack each other.
The first-level stronghold can only accommodate ten people. The ten people who arrive each time are randomly matched among the members from each world. If you are lucky, you may be matched with compatriots from your own country, but in most cases, they arrive with members from other strange worlds. It is good luck to have a familiar face.
Fang Nanshan's luck was not very good this time. Except for a young man with a Western white face, the other eight people were all obviously alien races.Horns are strange-shaped limbs with claws or hooves.
"What bad luck. There are actually two evil Blue Star humans. Everyone, do you want to kill them first?" The members of the alien race obviously had more opinions. When they saw Fang Nanshan and the white man, they immediately gathered together like snakes and scorpions and looked at them warily.
It seems that the Blue Star human race has a good reputation.
"I'm from the Blue Star Chinese clan." Fang Nanshan said calmly.
"Oh, it turns out that he is the only honest Chinese in Blue Star, so that's okay." The alien race in the form of a unicorn with a pair of ox hooves breathed a sigh of relief, looked at Fang Nanshan seriously, and discussed with other aliens in a low voice.
"Traitor! The Chinese didn't actually join forces with the members of the Blue Star Alliance to deal with the outside world. Instead, they bowed their heads to the alien races and begged for mercy. What a shame for the human race! I will definitely expose the shameless behavior of your Chinese..." Xiao Baipi opened his eyes wide and looked at Fang Nanshan angrily, accusing loudly.
Fang Nanshan waved his hand, interrupting his impassioned speech, "Get out of here."
